sentences.text:
(Rajkumar Raghuwanshi Vs The State Of Madhya Pra
 Dated : 02-04-2026
Shri Harshit Raghuwanshi - Advocate for the petitioner.
Shri Mayur Gulati - Pl for respondent/State.

Heard on IA No. 18648/25, an application for stay the proceedings pending before the IIIrd Additional Sessions Judge, Sehore arising out of FIR bearing Crime No. 382/24 registered at Police Station Mandi District Sehore for the offences punishable under Section 376 of IPC.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has a good case on merits and prima facie,
is made out against the petitioner.
It is submitted that there is consensual relationship between the petitioner and the victim.
It is further submitted that relationship of the victim and petitioner started in the year 2021 and the date of incident is 15-06-2024.
The petitioner went to Sehore and stayed at hotel with the victim.

It is further submitted that the petitioner and the victim both are locals and the victim is well aware of the fact that the petitioner is married having one daughter and therefore, prima facie, no case is made out against the petitioner.
In view of the above, pending trial in ST No. 95/25 arising out of FIR bearing Crime No. 382/24 registered at Police Station Mandi District Sehore is stayed till the next date of hearing.
State is directed to serve the notice upon the victim.
(B. P. SHARMA) JUDGE PG 2 MCRC-35326-2025 Rajkumar Raghuwanshi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 2 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29943449/
